verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the whole banner into a thin band in the middle of the tall canvas. That leaves large dead grey areas above and below, and the quote and author text are tiny, so nothing is rearranged for the new shape. B is worse: the headline was pulled off the red panel and set in white on light grey, where it is almost invisible. It also wraps badly ('LIFE,' and 'YOU' sit alone on their lines), the red panel is now an empty box stuck in the corner, and the author name and a tiny skyline are crammed along the bottom edge. Together this breaks readability and the brand.
